programs.title: How She Caught A Killer

programs.title: You Better Watch Out
programs.desc: It's Christmas Eve and Aubrey is rushing to Chicago for the birth of her sister's baby. Her plane is grounded in a snowstorm, leaving her stranded for the night at a small-town airport.

programs.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
programs.desc: Despite being from different parts of the world, Raquel and Samir first bonded over their shared love of the ocean. Now married, they are racing to find the perfect coastal home.

programs.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programs.desc: Rachael prepares her favourite Sicilian dish, pasta con le sarde, or sardine pasta, using both canned fish and fresh sardines atop long-cut pasta.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.desc: Rachael makes a delicious pasta dish with a creamy pea sauce layered with fresh pecorino cheese, baby greens and sauteed Guanciale, an Italian salt-cured meat coated with sage and rosemary.

programs.title: Masterchef Australia
programs.desc: After a demonstration from Michelin starred chef Vicky Cheng, three cooks must recreate his ‘Three Ages of Daikon Radish' vegetarian dish, from memory alone, the winner claiming immunity.

programs.title: 1,000 Ways To Dine
programs.desc: Grab your map and your appetite as host Michael Yo sets his sights on the best off-road eats. Buckle up as we hit the backroads for bison burgers in Alabama and Brussels sprouts behind bars in Connecticut.

programs.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out
programs.desc: Dr. Lyndsey assists Dr. Lee with Lance's notoriously big bump, which halted his rap dreams. Shelby has lost control of her sweet tooth, her health and the mystery bumps she has developed.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.desc: Rachael prepares a classic pesto sauce using fresh basil, roasted pistachios and pine nuts, combined with pecorino and parmesan cheeses. She then cooks it 'Lucca Style', with potatoes and green beans.

programs.title: Mama's Little Murderer
programs.desc: Devoted single mother Constance struggles to balance her newfound love with Leo and the obsessive, destructive behaviour of her son, Anthony, who will go to extreme lengths to keep her to himself.

programs.title: A Model Murder
programs.desc: When web model Kara gets disturbing messages from a fan, influencer Cody comes to her aid. But when the stalker begins to show up in person, 'IRL' takes on a whole new level of meaning for Kara.

programs.title: Got To Leave Something
programs.desc: South Korean actor Kim Nam-gil embarks on a journey with his companion, Lee Sang-yoon. Their first destination is the Punch Bowl village, a place marked by the pain of the divided Korean Peninsula.
